# EMclipper
AI that turns long videos into viral shorts in seconds.

## Overview
EMclipper is an AI-powered video editing platform designed for podcasters, vloggers, and content creators. It automatically analyzes your long-form videos (MP4, MOV, WEBM), finds the most engaging highlights, and generates TikTok-ready or YouTube Shorts-ready clips.

## Features
- Upload unlimited size videos
- Automated highlight detection
- Dynamic caption generation

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind-like styling
- Backend: Python, FastAPI
- Database/Auth: Supabase
- Payments: Stripe
- Hosting: Google Cloud Run & Cloudflare
